source.note: The article publishes the scorecard as a table. This JSON schema, IDs, descriptions, reference facts, and grading harness are maintained by Tracecat.

alert.context: Detection of a security rule deletion on the events.amazonaws.com service.

hard_gate.source_label: hard fail Disposition is True Positive
hard_gate.description: The report unambiguously concludes that the alert is a true positive.

validation_gates.description: Explains the credentials-exfiltration mechanism involving the attacker's Lambda activity in phase P7.
Identifies malicious VPC peering performed through the attacker's Lambda activity.

validation_gates.source_label: P6 Lambda 4 + 5 / SG of RDS + EKS API server opened
validation_gates.description: Identifies that security groups protecting RDS and the EKS API server were opened.

validation_gates.source_label: P6 All Lambda creations come from ack-lambda-controller identity
validation_gates.description: Attributes all malicious Lambda creations to the ack-lambda-controller identity.

validation_gates.source_label: P6 All API calls come from the controller Pod (Python entrypoint)
validation_gates.description: Connects the malicious AWS API calls to the ACK controller pod and its Python entrypoint.
Identifies orchestrator-sa patching the aws-auth ConfigMap to add cross-account access.

validation_gates.source_label: P5 orchestrator-sa / Deployment of the rootkit + implant as DaemonSet
validation_gates.description: Identifies orchestrator-sa deploying the rootkit and implant as a DaemonSet.

validation_gates.source_label: P5 orchestrator backdoored through CI runner credentials reuse
validation_gates.description: Explains that the orchestrator image was backdoored by reusing credentials harvested from the CI runner.

validation_gates.source_label: P4 Deployment of rootkit + implant as Static Pod
validation_gates.description: Identifies deployment of the rootkit and implant as a static pod through the node's manifests directory.

validation_gates.source_label: P3 monitoring-sa / Exec in existing node-debugger through kubelet API
validation_gates.description: Explains how monitoring-sa access to nodes/proxy enabled direct kubelet exec into an existing node-debugger pod.

validation_gates.source_label: P3 app-1 / Arbitrary file-read exploited in monitoring to get monitoring-sa token
validation_gates.description: Explains that app-1 exploited monitoring's arbitrary-file-read flaw to steal the monitoring-sa token.

validation_gates.source_label: P2 app-1 backdoored through GitHub cache poisoning
validation_gates.description: Explains that app-1 was backdoored through GitHub Actions cache poisoning.

validation_gates.source_label: P1 External msan actor ran workflow in dev context
validation_gates.description: Identifies the external msan actor causing untrusted pull-request code to run in the dev workflow context.

known_legitimate_activity: The human activity from 67.67.67.67 using admin or eks-admin, including creating and using node-debugger, belongs to a legitimate operator rather than the attacker.
Kerberosse merging the S3 remediator pull request on 2026-08-13 is legitimate and occurred after the malicious infrastructure already existed.
The s3-remediator Lambda schedule and its recurring S3 ListBuckets activity are legitimate and are not part of the attack chain.
